name: Merope
description: A star 117 parsecs away, 7.7 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17608: radius 7.747 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 211.434 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.783) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17608: effective temperature 7913 +/- 3358 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.448)

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 17608: distance 116.55 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.043), at which the luminosity and radius hold

limb.none: no mass is measured and no spectroscopic surface gravity is published with this radius: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770 assume the gravity of their fit (table column 15)

text.card: A star 117 parsecs away, 7.7 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 211 times the Sun's luminosity at 7,913 K, so 7.747 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 17608: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Merope (star)
quotes.card: Merope, designated 23 Tauri, is a star in the constellation of Taurus and a member of the Pleiades star cluster.
quotes.introduction: It is approximately 440 light-years (135 pc) away.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 65205373152172032 (quality E), from 1953GCRV..C......0W; Gaia DR3 measures none
